steps.body: A take-from story starts with a group and removes part of it.
steps.narration: A take-from story starts with a group and removes part of it.

widget.prompt: A basket holds 8 apples. 3 are taken out. Hop back to the new total.

commonLandings.feedback: That is the number before any were taken out.
That counts what was removed, not what stayed in the basket.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 8 and count back 3: you land on 5.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents koa take from story.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for koa take from story must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines koa take from story.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: Taking from a group makes it smaller.
